products.name: FormPortal
products.summary: One place to install, open and update every Form app.

stable.notes: https://github.com/nodemode-dev/formportal/releases/tag/v0.71.4

history.notes:
This release carries 0.71.0, 0.71.1 and 0.71.2 as well, which were never published on their own.

New

- Stock & templates searches Pexels, Pixabay, Openverse, Freesound and ccMixter for images, video and audio. Each result opens in a viewer with its licence, its credit line and Save. Openverse and ccMixter need no key; the other three use your own free API key.
- Templates and demos for every public Form app, from the public repository nodemode-dev/formai-templates. Nothing is fetched until you choose Get the list, each file is downloaded only when you choose it, and it is kept only if its SHA-256 matches the list.
- Fonts can come from Fontsource, with no account, and from Google Fonts, with your own API key. Nothing is asked of either until you press Browse. Your own font files can always be added.
- Preferences has a Keys panel for your API keys. It shows what each key is for, whether one is kept, its last four characters and where it is kept. A source that needs a key has a chip that opens the panel.
- An install or a going back shows a card under the app's row that ticks each check as it really happens: the catalogue's signature, the file for this computer, the download, the SHA-256, unpacking and moving into place.
- Files: a project's name opens an inspector with its path, preview, size, kept versions and whether the file still matches its last kept SHA-256.
- Profile can connect to GitHub and set up your own fork of the extension registry. Nothing is sent to GitHub until you press Connect to GitHub.
- The sidebar carries the family's social links, with Help last.

Improved

- Every app row on Updates and Apps is one line high, with the installed version and the download size in a pill in the app's own colour.
- What changed opens in place under the row without moving the rows above.
- Notices show five lines at most, leave by themselves after 5 seconds, and are red only for a failure.
- Every app page has its own text and a How it works section.
- The three browser demos show this interface and ask nothing outside the page.

Changed

- FormPortal asks formai.studio nothing about what is on the way unless you turn on Preferences, General, Ask formai.studio what is on the way. It is off by default. When it is on, FormPortal asks once at each start.
- The system keychain is asked only when you save or remove a key or use a feature that needs it. Where a computer has no keychain, a key is kept in a file only you can read, and the Keys panel says so.
- Preferences, Account is now Profile. Version and Check & repair moved to General.
- The Apps page is one section in ten categories, and each app's "Instead of" line follows what its repository says today. SubForm is now FormSubstrate.

Fixed

- A file the download server does not have yet is reported as that, not as a file that does not match the catalogue. Nothing is written or installed in either case.

Known issues

- The stock sources, Fontsource, Google Fonts, the templates download and GitHub's connect and fork were built to each service's documentation and have not yet been tried against the live services.
- The Spanish has not been read by a native speaker.

This release carries 0.70.1 as well, which was never published on its own.

Changed

- An extension package that reaches FormPortal from outside its window (a formai:// link, a .formpkg file opened with FormPortal, or another program) is no longer installed straight away. FormPortal shows a dialog with the file and its path, and installs only when you press Install. Cancel leaves nothing installed.
- A file you drop on the window still installs at once, as before.

Fixed

- Command line and agents: installing an extension from a package file now follows your choice for outside agents, as installing, updating, rolling back and removing an app already do. Under Ask and Blocked it is refused, under Allowed it goes on to the usual package checks. Installing by id from the signed index is unchanged.

Improved

- The pages for other Form apps name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity wherever the app itself offers all four, FormWav and FormRef included.
- Three sentences on the pages for FormFabric, FormSculpt and FormTools have their missing space back.
- The new dialog's sentences are in Spanish too, and the three browser demos are rebuilt with all of the above.

products.name: Format
products.summary: A chat and agent workspace for the Claude API, with a terminal, artifacts and documents.

stable.notes:
A small release about the Browser pane. Nothing changes in how you use it.

Improved

- The page shown in the Browser pane is now sent only to the FormAT window. Other programs on your computer that ask for it are refused.

Unchanged

- Agents you connect over MCP or the command line work as before. They follow your Outside agents choice in Settings: Ask, Allowed or Blocked.
- No new commands in this version.

products.name: FormBench
products.summary: Parity, testing and feedback for the Form apps, kept on this computer.

products.name: FormCAD
products.summary: CAD studio: 2D drafting, parametric parts, NURBS surfaces and automation on OpenCascade.

stable.notes:
Surface work. This release carries 0.29.0 as well, which was never published on its own.

New

- Surfaces: fillet, chamfer and variable-radius fillet between two surfaces that share an edge or cross, trimmed back and joined (srffillet, srfchamfer, srfvarfillet).
- Drag the control points of a surface in the 3D view. The surface follows live with zebra stripes, and each drag is one undo step.
- Untrim gives a trimmed surface back its whole surface or removes only its holes. Shrink Trimmed cuts the underlying surface down to its trim.
- Curves from surfaces: project curves onto surfaces, pull them on along the surface normal, cut contours at even spacing, and extract isocurves (crvproject, crvpull, srfcontour, srfisocurve).
- Deform solids and surfaces: Bend, Flow along Curve, Flow along Surface and Cage Edit under Modify, Deform. A closed solid stays closed, and resetting a cage returns the original.

Improved

- 3DM export writes each body as one trimmed, joined polysurface, so a solid opens as a closed solid in the receiving program. A body that cannot be written this way falls back to separate faces, and the export report says why.
- The seam continuity check measures G3, and the seam badge in the 3D view shows it.
- The new labels are translated in every language.

Fixed

- Surface match and extend work on surfaces shown in the 3D view. Before, they failed there with "could not be converted to a B-spline surface".

Known issues

- The new tools need the 3D kernel released with this version. An older kernel says so.
- The cage has no handles in the 3D view yet. Its points are moved from the command line.

history.notes:
The first public release of FormCAD. It carries everything from 0.20.1 to 0.28.0.

New

- Drawings: a hole table lists the holes seen in a view, with a tag beside each hole, and follows the part when it changes. A revision table lists the drawing's revisions.
- Parts: modelled threads, Thicken for faces and sheet bodies, and Delete Face that heals or patches the gap. They need the 3D kernel released with this version; an older kernel says so.
- Assemblies open with lightweight components that load in full only when a command needs them, and have five new mates: symmetric, width, path, slot and cam.
- Sketches: a midpoint relation, splines in relations, and a status bar chip that shows the state of what you selected. Fillets, chamfers and face sketches stay where they were when you edit an early sketch.
- Hole and fastener sizes come from published standards, each with its source. A value that could not be read is left for you to type.
- DWG has two routes. A converter you install yourself works as before. New are the DWG tools, a separate program FormCAD downloads and checks file by file: with them it opens DWG and saves DWG in the 2000 format only, and the save dialog says so. They appear in Preferences once they are published.
- Images and PDF pages can be placed under a drawing, clipped and faded. Publish takes sheets from several drawings into one PDF. A table can link to an Excel workbook as well as to CSV.
- The interface speaks 29 languages besides English and starts in your system's language. In Arabic the window mirrors.
- Agents: the MCP server describes the whole studio, formcad_status says whether the 3D kernel and the mesher are installed, and an agent can open and export STEP, IGES, 3DM and mesh files and follow a simulation study or a toolpath run to its end. The server offers a short list of tools by default; every command stays reachable.

Improved

- FormCAD has its own accent, a violet. An accent you chose yourself is kept.
- Panels in the side column can be moved and given a height of their own. Reset Panels puts everything back.
- Nothing jumps when a drawing or a graph opens from Home.
- The README and SECURITY.md say what FormCAD sends over the network: the kernel and mesher downloads, a render environment when you ask for one, and nothing else. Render environment downloads are checked with SHA-256.
- DXF: what could not be kept on import is listed in the import notes instead of being dropped silently.

Fixed

- Windows: closing or ending FormCAD also ends its engine. Before, the engine could stay behind.
- An engine that cannot be started shows a message and exits. Before, the window vanished without a word.
- Drawings: dimension and balloon commands work on drawing views, and dimensions on a view follow a model change at once.

Known issues

- Home, the menus, Preferences, the agent dock and the Studies panel are translated. Other panels and the engine's messages are still in English, and the translations have not been read by native speakers.
- A drawing with multiline text or angular dimensions does not save through the DWG tools yet: the save stops with a message and writes no file.

products.name: FormCel
products.summary: Spreadsheets on your own machine, with Excel files in and out.

stable.notes:
FormCel takes the Form family's look, and starts and closes more cleanly on Windows. This release carries 0.47.0 as well, which was never published on its own.

New

- On Windows the engine now closes when you close FormCel, and a start that fails says why in a window of its own.
- The agent panel is the Form family's shared panel, and its guide covers Codex, Cursor and Antigravity beside Claude Code.

Improved

- The window uses the same colours, corners and fonts as FormVis: quiet text, the green and amber of status marks, slightly tighter corners on menus and in Preferences, and your system's own interface font first (San Francisco on macOS, Segoe UI on Windows).
- Your accent colour, the text size and the order in which panels and menus stack are unchanged.
- The data model view shows its error text in the family's red.
- On Windows no console window opens beside the app.
- The offline demo (demo/index.html, with the What-if and Lab pages) is rebuilt from this version. It had stayed at 0.43.0.

Fixed

- macOS: an engine that had just ended could still be counted as running, which could hold up the next start.

products.name: FormCraft
products.summary: Images, video, audio, 3D and worlds from models you choose, on your own keys and your own computer.

products.name: FormCut
products.summary: Video editing on your own machine: cut, grade, caption and export.

stable.notes:
A small fix release for the files FormCut downloads for itself.

Fixed

- When a file from the first download address fails its integrity check, FormCut now removes it and tries the next address. Before, it stopped.
- When no address gives the right file, the message names the address that gave the wrong one, and nothing from it is kept.

products.name: FormDAM
products.summary: A library for every photo, video and asset you keep.

stable.notes:
A small release about starting and closing the app. Nothing changes in your library.

New

- On Windows the engine now closes when you close FormDAM, so nothing is left running in the background.
- When the engine cannot start, the window says why instead of waiting without a word.

Improved

- On Windows no console window opens beside the app.

Fixed

- macOS: an engine that had just ended could still be counted as running, which could hold up the next start.

products.name: FormDesign
products.summary: Page layout and PDF work in one app: lay out, publish, read, sign and edit.

stable.notes:
A small release that makes the Windows installer more dependable. Nothing changes in how you use FormDesign.

Fixed

- Windows: building the installer now stops with a clear error when one of the app's helper programs cannot be put in place. Before, it could go on and produce an installer without it.

Under the hood

- Notes that sat inside the desktop shell's source moved to its log.

products.name: FormEncoder
products.summary: Convert, compress and export media in batches, with presets.

stable.notes:
This is the first release since 0.11.0. It carries 0.12.0 and 0.13.0 as well, which were never published on their own.

New

- On Windows the engine now closes when you close FormEncoder, so nothing is left running in the background.
- When the engine cannot start, the window says why instead of waiting without a word.
- The agent panel is the Form family's shared panel. Its guide covers all four agent programs: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity.

Improved

- On Windows no black console window opens beside the app any more.
- Every colour, size and layer name of the Form family's design now exists in FormEncoder, so shared panels look the same here as in FormVis. The look of the window does not change.
- In AMOLED Black the panels sit on pure black, as in the other Form apps. They were a shade lighter.

Fixed

- macOS: an engine that had just ended could still be counted as running, which could hold up the next start.
- Antigravity: every agent tab keeps a folder of its own, so two tabs no longer write over each other's entry.
- Windows: the installer is built again. 0.12.0 and 0.13.0 could not be built for Windows because of a packaging mistake.
- Windows: the MP3 encoder (LAME) and the Content Credentials tool (c2patool) are built correctly for 64-bit Windows.

products.name: form.ext
products.summary: The extension studio: make, preview, check, package and publish extensions for every Form app.

stable.notes:
This release carries 0.9.0 as well, which was never published on its own.

New

- The agent panel is the Form family's shared panel, and the manual names all four agent programs: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity.

Improved

- Every style name FormVis uses now works in Form.ext too, each one following Form.ext's own colours, sizes and three themes. A panel shared across the family looks right here without changes, and nothing in Form.ext looks different.
- On a slow first start the window waits up to 90 seconds for the engine instead of giving up early.
- On Windows no console window opens beside the app.
- The browser demo you open from demo/index.html is rebuilt. It shows this version and everything added since 0.4.1, and it opens with no error in the browser's console.

Fixed

- macOS: an engine that had just ended could still be counted as running, which could hold up the next start.

products.name: FormFabric
products.summary: Garment pattern design and cloth simulation: draw patterns, sew, drape and export.

stable.notes:
This release carries 0.29.1 as well, which was never published on its own.

New

- AMOLED Black, a true-black theme for OLED screens, as in the other Form apps. Pick it in the theme list.

Fixed

- At each start the window asked the engine for live updates a moment too early, was refused once and asked again a second and a half later. It now waits until it is signed in, so live updates arrive from the first try.

products.name: FormLit
products.summary: Photo library and raw development on your own machine.

stable.notes:
This release carries 0.55.0 as well, which was never published on its own.

New

- Preferences has a field each for the Codex, Cursor and Antigravity programs, right under the Claude Code one. Leave a field empty and FormLit finds the program by itself; type a path and FormLit looks there first.
- Those places are protected the same way as your agent access choice: only the FormLit window can change them.
- The agent panel is the Form family's shared panel, and its guide covers Codex, Cursor and Antigravity beside Claude Code.

Improved

- When Codex, Cursor or Antigravity is not found, the message now also says you can give its path in Preferences.
- On a slow first start the window waits up to 90 seconds for the engine instead of giving up early.
- On Windows no console window opens beside the app.
- FormLit now carries every colour and layout name the rest of the Form family uses. Nothing looks different.

Fixed

- Preferences: saving a Claude Code path that FormLit cannot run no longer pushes the fields below it down. Nothing in the window moves when Preferences opens or a value is saved.
- macOS: an engine that had just ended could still be counted as running, which could hold up the next start.
- An agent access choice saved by 0.54.0 is kept after the update.

Known issues

- Two sentences of the terminal panel's guide, the ones that name Codex, Cursor and Antigravity, are in English in every language.

products.name: formMCP
products.summary: One MCP connection from Claude Code, Codex and Cursor to every Form app.

stable.notes:
A small release that brings the demos and pictures up to date. Nothing changes in how you connect a server.

Improved

- Demo 2 now shows the note FormMCP gives about an older Antigravity settings file.
- The window preview in the Demos panel and the picture at the top of the README show today's window with all four agent programs: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity.

products.name: Form.md
products.summary: Notes, docs and databases built on plain Markdown files.

stable.notes:
A small release: one fix for the desktop app, and a guide for hosting form.md yourself.

New
- Hosting: a step-by-step guide, .docs/SELF_HOSTING.md, for putting your own copy of form.md on your own domain for a small team, with the wiki pages Self-hosting and Auth0.
- Hosting: scripts in deploy/gcp that create a server in Google Cloud and install form.md on it with automatic HTTPS, encrypted data and a daily snapshot.

Improved
- Desktop app: when you open http://127.0.0.1:8750 in a browser, the sign-in page now says that the app has no password until you set one, and where to set it.
- Profile: an account with no password shows "No password set yet" instead of asking for a current password, and the button reads Set password.

Fixed
- Desktop app: you can now set a first password in Settings, Profile. Before, the app asked for a current password that had never been set, so no password could be set and a browser could not sign in.
- Accounts made by single sign-on can set a first password in the same way.

history.notes:
A small release for the desktop app. Nothing changes in how you write, and nothing changes for a server you start from a terminal.

Improved

- Desktop app: at every start the app's own server makes a fresh key for the window and accepts it once. The window signs you in with it, as before, with no extra step for you.
- Desktop app: when the server starts without handing over that key, the app stops with a sentence that says so instead of opening a window that cannot sign in.

Fixed

- The list of third-party notices (NOTICES.md) is complete after every build: the media of the three in-app demos and the extension kit are listed again.

products.name: FormMorpheus
products.summary: Animation studio: draw frame by frame, keyframe or perform live on a timeline.

stable.notes: https://github.com/nodemode-dev/formmorpheus/releases/tag/v0.30.0

history.notes:
The first public release of FormMorpheus. It carries everything from 0.18.4 to 0.23.3.

New

- A terminal panel beside the Stage and the Timeline: View, Terminal. It runs a shell, and Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity when they are installed on your computer. FormMorpheus does not install them or sign you in.
- An MCP server, so an agent can read your library, create, rename, duplicate, delete and restore movies, and export or import.
- Agents ask first. Preferences, Agents has Outside agents: Ask (the default), Allowed or Blocked. An export or an import always asks, whatever you chose.
- Preferences, Video Tools shows where ffmpeg was found and what it can make, with a button that downloads the family's ffmpeg build, checks every file and can remove it again. An ffmpeg already on your computer is used.
- Home opens with a side column: Movies, Recent, Start, Exports and Recently Deleted with their counts, and Preferences and Help at the foot. The poster wall is still there under Preferences, General.
- A violet accent, FormMorpheus's own, and AMOLED Black among the themes. An accent you picked yourself is kept.
- New Movie: 25 fps joins the frame rates.

Improved

- Colours, corner sizes and text sizes are the family's across the whole interface, so every theme recolours every part of it.
- All 30 languages have every string. Nothing falls back to English.
- Only the FormMorpheus window can talk to its engine, and the engine listens on this computer only.
- When the app cannot start, a message says why and where the engine's log is. Before, the app closed without a word.
- Your theme, language and preferences are kept from one launch to the next on every system.
- Help: every button in the Help Center opens something. The Manual opens inside the app and works offline.

Changed

- Frame rates have FormMorpheus's own labels: On twos, Web and GIF, Film, Video, Smooth (Europe), Smooth and Extra smooth. Movies keep their rate.
- Brush sets have FormMorpheus's own names and order. Brushes you chose, sets you renamed and your own order are kept.
- macOS: the installer asks for macOS 13 or later, which the app needs.

Fixed

- Windows: closing the app, or ending it in Task Manager, also ends its engine, and no console window opens beside the app.
- macOS: FormMorpheus opened from Finder or the Dock finds an ffmpeg installed with Homebrew or MacPorts, so ProRes, HEVC and MP3 export are offered.
- The export progress and the Close button no longer move while an export runs, and the status bar no longer shifts when a movie opens.

Under the hood

- The Linux AppImage carries only GStreamer's core, base, good and gl plug-ins, and NOTICE.md lists every third-party part the app carries.

products.name: FormNET
products.summary: The network tab for the whole computer: what websites, apps and the machine actually send.

stable.notes:
The first public release of FormNET: the network tab for your whole computer.

New

- Flows: every request that passes through FormNET's local proxy, with its headers, bodies up to a limit, sizes, timings and the TLS that was negotiated. Click a flow to read what was sent and what came back.
- Hosts: requests, errors and bytes each way per host, grouped by domain. Widely documented third parties get a reading-aid label, never a verdict.
- Machine: every connection the computer holds, with the process that owns it.
- Change what passes: rewrite headers, addresses, status or bodies, answer from a local file, block a host, pause a request to edit it, resend any request, or slow everything to 3G.
- macOS and Windows: FormNET can point the system proxy at itself while it runs.
- Find it, keep it: filter by status, method, type, size, time, process or host, or type status-code:404 as in a browser's tools; search inside bodies; read JSON, HTML, images and WebSocket messages; save a session, import a HAR, copy anything as cURL.
- Agents: formnet mcp is an MCP server with 10 tools that reads the same recording. Scripts use a token-guarded local API, and formnet snapshot prints the connection table as JSON.
- The standalone server binaries are released beside the app, with an archive of the licence texts that apply to them.

Improved

- Both listeners bind to this computer only, unless you let a phone or another computer use the proxy. Recordings stay in memory until you save or export them.
- The app carries the licence text of everything it ships: its typefaces, its terminal, the Go runtime and every Rust crate the window links.
- Updates come through FormPortal. FormNET has no account, no telemetry and no updater of its own.

products.name: FormPath
products.summary: Vector illustration: paths, shapes, type and artboards.

stable.notes:
Telling FormPath where each agent program is. This release carries 0.58.0 as well, which was never published on its own.

New

- Preferences > Plugins has an Agent Programs group with a field for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity: where each program is on this computer, for when FormPath does not find it by itself. Leave a field empty and FormPath looks in the usual places, as before.
- What you enter there is protected: only the FormPath window can change it. If the settings file is changed by hand, none of the places is used until you enter them again in Preferences, which then says so.
- On Windows the engine now closes when you close FormPath, and a start that fails says why.
- The agent panel is the Form family's shared panel, and the MCP note names all four agent programs.

Improved

- When Codex, Cursor or Antigravity is not found, the message now says its place can be given in Preferences.
- On Windows no console window opens beside the app.
- FormPath now carries every colour and size name it shares with FormVis.
- The three browser demos are rebuilt.

Fixed

- macOS: an engine that had just ended could still be counted as running, which could hold up the next start.
- A Claude Code place saved by an earlier FormPath is kept after the update.

products.name: FormPDF
products.summary: A PDF editor that runs on your computer: view, comment, fill, sign and edit.

stable.notes:
This release carries 0.64.0 and 0.65.0 as well, which were never published on their own.

New

- On Windows the engine now closes when you close FormPDF, and a start that fails says why.
- FormPDF can remember where Codex, Cursor and Antigravity are on your computer, protected the same way as the place of Claude Code.
- The agent panel is the Form family's shared panel. Its guide, the terminal help and every sentence that lists the agent programs name all four: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity.

Improved

- On Windows no console window opens beside the app.
- FormPDF now carries every colour and size name the Form family uses, so shared panels look the same here as in FormVis. Labels and other quiet text take the family's grey.

Fixed

- macOS: an engine that had just ended could still be counted as running, which could hold up the next start.
- Antigravity: folders left behind by a start that ended badly are cleared at the next start.
- An agent choice saved by 0.64.0 is kept after the update.

products.name: FormPromo
products.summary: Promo films from your own media, style and sourced claims.

products.name: FormPublisher
products.summary: Open FormWeb sites, check every route, package them and prepare them for hosts.

stable.notes: https://github.com/nodemode-dev/formpublisher/releases/tag/v0.11.0

history.notes:
The first public release of FormPublisher. It carries everything from 0.4.0 to 0.10.1.

New

- Eight whole sites to start from: three demo sites and a business, a portfolio, a blog, an event and a shop window. Each card shows its site type, and chips filter the list. Nothing is fetched until you ask, and a file is kept only if its SHA-256 matches the list.
- A guide for hosting a site yourself, in the window under Help and on each prepared host's card, with parts on forms and on analytics and search engines.
- Forms that work on a static host. A form with nowhere to send its data is an error that names the Forms part of the guide.
- A live-site check, in Publish and on the command line. After you deploy, it reads your own public address only when you press the button and confirm.
- Checks for search and sharing: one canonical link per page, the four Open Graph tags, structured data that parses, and each language version naming the others. The deep check measures text contrast and reports the largest contentful paint and the layout shift for each route and width.
- The agent dock: View, Agent Dock opens a terminal panel with a shell and a tab for each of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity that is on your computer.
- Agents can do everything the window does, through 29 tools and 27 commands. Each tool says what it may change.
- Verify tells you who signed. A signature made with one of your keys says so with the key's name; a valid signature from a key you do not have is a warning.
- Export and Import for signing keys: a key leaves as a PEM file encrypted with a passphrase you choose.

Improved

- FormPublisher looks like the rest of the FormAI family, in its own green. An accent you picked yourself is kept.
- The routes column, the inspector and the bottom panel can be resized and remember their size.
- Signing keys are kept in your system's password store, which is opened only to create, sign, export, import or remove a key.
- When the engine cannot start, the app says why, with the engine's last lines and the path of its log.
- Deep checks work in the installed app with the Chrome or Edge you already have. Nothing is downloaded.
- Help, Documentation opens the manual that ships inside the app, with the network off too.
- The check messages, Prepare notes and live-check findings are translated in all 26 languages.

Changed

- Only the FormPublisher window, its command line and its MCP server can change anything. A site you preview cannot reach the app.
- The Intel Mac build needs macOS 14. Apple silicon stays at macOS 13.

Fixed

- Windows: ending the app by any means ends its engine, and the engine has no console window.
- A deep check that fails shows an error in Problems with the reason. Before, it ended as if it had passed.

products.name: FormRec
products.summary: Recording for walkthroughs, podcasts, corporate messages and live feeds, by a person or by an agent.

products.name: FormRef
products.summary: Reference boards for images, ideas and creative work.

stable.notes:
A small fix release.

Fixed

- A picture's caption is now easy to read in every theme: light text on its dark strip, in the light themes too.

Under the hood

- Notes that sat inside the desktop shell's source moved to its log. Nothing changes in how the app works.

products.name: FormRig
products.summary: Character rigging: skeleton, skin, controls, face and retargeting from any mesh.

products.name: FormSculpt
products.summary: 3D sculpting and modeling, with a Rust engine and a command set agents can drive.

stable.notes:
New

- AMOLED Black, a true-black theme for OLED screens, as in the other Form apps. Pick it in the Theme menu, in Preferences or in the View section.
- Every layout follows it: the panel layout, the ZUI layout, the tablet layout, menus, dialogs, the agent panel with its terminal, and the viewport's background. The window is black from its first frame.
- When the Form family's shared theme is AMOLED Black, FormSculpt follows it.

Fixed

- The viewport's background now follows a theme's black. The bottom of High Contrast's gradient did not turn black.
- The description of the Show Terminal command now says the panel is under the viewport or at its right, in every language.

products.name: formskills
products.summary: The Form apps' released skills: read them, download them, keep your own edits.

stable.notes:
This release carries 0.12.0 as well, which was never published on its own.

New

products.name: FormSlot
products.summary: Codebase memory for coding agents: what is built, where it lives and the rules it follows.

stable.notes:
The first public release of FormSlot: codebase memory for coding agents. It is a command line program with no window; it runs on your own machine, in Rust and SQLite.

New

- Slots: a slot is a manifest for code worth reusing, with its files, hashes and every copy found. 26 slots come with the first load.
- Drift: for a repository, which copies of a slot are clean, local, behind or diverged.
- Recall: ranked memory records with a token estimate, for example formslot recall "seam carving".
- Packs: formslot pack joins the slots, memory and code excerpts a task needs under the token budget you give.
- Five languages are parsed: TypeScript, Python, Rust, CSS and HTML, with a call and use graph per repository.
- Agents: an MCP server with 13 tools over stdio and HTTP, on the same store as the command line. Eleven tools only read; slot_reindex and slot_remember write FormSlot's own store and nothing else.
- Claude Code: formslot install adds the MCP server, the hooks, the lookup and curation skills and the scout agent.
- Codex, Cursor and Antigravity: formslot connect adds the MCP server to each program's own settings file.

Improved

- When another program already uses the service port, formslot start says so and tells you how to choose another with FORMSLOT_PORT. formslot doctor shows the same advice.

stable.notes:
This is the first release since 2.28.0. It carries 2.29.0, 2.30.0 and 2.31.0 as well, which were never published on their own.

New

- One engine per data folder. Starting FormWav replaces an engine left over from an earlier session, and the engine leaves by itself when its app is gone.
- On Windows the engine closes when you close FormWav, and a start that fails says why.
- Settings, Agents names Antigravity beside Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, and the agent panel is the Form family's shared panel.

Improved

- On a slow first start the window waits up to 90 seconds for the engine instead of giving up early.
- On Windows no console window flashes open, neither for the engine nor for the tools it runs.

Fixed

- Timeline: nothing moves on screen when the rendering of a note track arrives late.
- Windows: a rendering is saved even while its file is still being read. It could fail with an error before.
- Antigravity: every agent tab keeps a folder of its own, so two tabs no longer share one entry.
- Windows: the installer is built again. 2.31.0 could not be built for Windows because of a packaging mistake.

products.name: FormWeb
products.summary: Design and publish web pages visually.

stable.notes: https://github.com/nodemode-dev/formweb/releases/tag/v0.31.1

history.notes:
Five whole-site starters, one for each common kind of site.

New

- Five starters join the demos: Coldmere Plumbing (a local business with services and prices), Northfold Studio (a designer's portfolio with project pages), The Slow Allotment (a blog with a post archive), Wenlow Type Day (a one-day event with programme, speakers, venue and tickets) and Fernhollow Pottery (a shop window whose orders go by email). Each is a complete site you can edit.
- In the starters, project, post, speaker and product pages are CMS collections, so adding a project or a post is adding an item.
- Each demo has a site type (business, portfolio, blog, event or shop), in the app and in a demo.json beside its file, so tools that offer the demos can sort them.

Improved

- Preview shows all eight demos, and its bar scrolls sideways when the window is narrow.
- The five new demo descriptions are in all 23 translated languages.

Known issues

- The share picture's address is written into each starter's head code. Change it by hand along with the base URL.
- No starter has a form: people get in touch by email.
- The new translations have not been read by a native speaker.

This release carries 0.26.0 as well, which was never published on its own.

New

- On Windows the engine now closes when you close FormWeb, and a start that fails says why.
- The agent panel is the Form family's shared panel, and its guide covers Codex, Cursor and Antigravity beside Claude Code.

Improved

- Agent Connect says how each agent program gets FormWeb's tools. With Agents off, the note says that Chat and the Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity tabs opened from FormWeb still work, and that turning Agents on lets a program you start yourself connect.
- The note under the program cards says what each tab reads, and that a program started outside FormWeb reads its project file (Antigravity: its account file) and needs Agents on. Before, the notes named only Codex and Cursor.
- FormWeb's style sheet now defines every design name of the Form family, so shared parts from the other apps find the values they expect. Nothing on screen changes, in dark or in light.

Fixed

- macOS: an engine that had just ended could still be counted as running, which could hold up the next start.

Under the hood

- For people who build FormWeb on Windows: FORMWEB_ENGINE_WINDOWED=0 builds an engine with a console, for debugging.
